description: Sources by the dozen and not one `type`, `interface` or `enum` among them. The denominator of point 10 is the exported type, so a pattern that has stopped reading them holds every index of the library to an empty list of names and finds it kept — the same silence as a parse that stops finding decorators, one point further on. A library that really declared no type would be a library with no public surface to speak of, which is why the answer here is always the reader and never the tree.
